hazards.control: Only qualified people at the drive, transformer, and junction box; lockout before cable work.

name: Power cable and wellhead penetrator
function: The three-phase cable banded to the tubing from the motor to the wellhead penetrator that carries it through the tubing hanger.

tabs.overview: Round cable in the vertical, flat cable across the pump; clamps every joint; the penetrator seals the conductors through the hanger.
tabs.engineering: Rated for the temperature and gas; voltage drop over the length.
tabs.safety: Medium voltage; damaged on running if the clamps are missed.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
